rights_basis: Faithful mechanical source images or a bounded checked transcription of the original Latin Paris 1657 printing, whose United States publication term has expired. The FIDES edition 3755 holding page, re-read on 2026-10-20, marks the Krzeszów Benedictine abbey copy Domena publiczna (Public domain) and access Dla wszystkich bez ograniczeń. The historical wording and mechanical images are excluded from Triptych’s CC BY 4.0 grant. No modern translation, critical reconstruction, or newly composed prayer is supplied. Historical availability does not authorize contemporary liturgical use.
text: SVpra quæ propítio ac seréno vultu respícere dignéris: & accépta habére, sícuti accépta habére dignátus es múnera púeri tui iusti Abel, & sacrifícium Patriárchæ nostri Abrahæ: & quod tibi óbtulit summus sacérdos tuus Melchísedech, sanctum sacrifícium, immaculátam hóstiam.
